title: Jungle Scene 5 — Busy Jungle Actions
purpose: Longer action descriptions in a lively but readable scene.

sentenceModels: The monkey is holding a banana.
The sloth is hanging from the branch.

adultSupport.focus: Help Basti describe several actions one after another without losing clarity.
starterPrompts: Can you find the jumping animal?
Which animal is walking through the grass?
expansionPrompts: Tell me three things happening in the jungle.
Can you make a long sentence about the elephant?

visualAudit: Monkey on a branch holding a banana.
Elephant spraying water on the left.
Frog jumping across leaves in front.
Parrot flying and sloth hanging above.
